description.en: Evaluates LLM generation of SystemVerilog assertions from structured design specifications and RTL, across two tasks: bug-prevention and bug-hunting. The benchmark includes 83 real-world designs with golden and mutated RTL, and assesses syntactic validity, formal provability, coverage, and mutation-based bug detection.

evidence.snippet: To address these limitations, we introduce AssertLLM2, an open-source benchmark for realistic assertion generation in hardware verification.

claire_radar.motivation: Assertion-based verification (ABV) is a cornerstone of modern hardware design, yet manually translating design intent into formal SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) remains labor-intensive and error-prone.
